snippet.title: Corgi Race Trailer (Available Now Steam)
snippet.description:
The greatest sport in the world is available now on Steam with the versatile sim game Corgi Race.

Raise and train your corgi from a promising puppy to a legendary champion with all the twists and turns that come on the track to success.

Stream corgi races live on Twitch for your chat to compete as they pick winners, exactas and trifectas with hopes of topping the in-game leaderboard.

Wishlist today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2823250/Corgi_Race/
